issue_comments.author: oscarbenjamin
issue_comments.body: I don't like overcomplicating CI. Can we not just make other checks wait for the mailmap check that is already there?

issue_comments.author: smichr
issue_comments.body: @oscarbenjamin , I was only thinking with so many new contributors that there is no sense running testing resources needlessly when the .mailmap is not ready. I suspect this would hardly need any maintenance once it is in place. I am +1/3 to adding it, so if you just want to close with WontFix that is ok with me.

issue_comments.author: oscarbenjamin
issue_comments.body:
The mailmap check has needed a lot of maintenance over the years.

I'm just suggesting a simpler approach: make it so that other jobs wait for .mailmap and code quality checks before running.

issue_comments.author: smichr
issue_comments.body: How about squashing this as an option?

issue_comments.author: smichr
issue_comments.body: @asmeurer @oscarbenjamin this no longer does anything to any scripts, just makes the author check a prereq.

issue_comments.author: smichr
issue_comments.body: @asmeurer it looks like both maintainers need to approve the change.

issue_comments.author: oscarbenjamin
issue_comments.body: I think it is approved already. The problem is the checks haven't completed. I'm not sure why they are not running but it seems like GitHub Actions is a bit paused or something.

title: mailmap and code quality must pass before other tests are run
